'''Yumi Touma''' (Japanese: '''冬馬由美''' ''Tōma Yumi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Touma was born as '''Yumi Nakagawa''' (Japanese: '''中川由美''' ''Nakagawa Yumi'') on December 20, 1966, in {{wp|Chiba (city)|Chiba}}, {{wp|Chiba Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She is often typecast as strong, beautiful women due to her mature voice. Touma has provided the voices of several {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} and [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] since {{aniseries|OS}}. Her most notable roles in {{aniseries|PTS}} are that of [[Caroline]] and [[Pichu Brothers|Pichu Big]]. Touma was once affiliated with {{wp|Aoni Production}}, but she left and has since founded her own agency, ALLURE&Y. She is currently married to Tatsuya Yoshida, a producer from {{wp|Toei Company}}.
